must_haves: The response names Veo 3 as the requested paid model.

turns.text: I'd like a 5-second widescreen clip of rain on a neon-lit street, with rain sounds, using Veo 3 only. The picker labels it paid and quotes 80 credits for this clip. I'm on the free tier, so check with me before spending anything.

dialog.agent:
I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

**Veo is paid-only**, so I can’t run this clip on your current free plan—even with approval for the quoted 80 credits. I won’t substitute another model.

The connected Veo tool also doesn’t support exactly 5 seconds; its shortest options are 4, 6, or 8 seconds. If you gain paid access, we can confirm the duration and updated cost before generating your widescreen neon-rain clip with rain sounds.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

dialog.agent:
The shortest option I listed was **4 seconds with Veo**, but Veo still can’t run on your free plan. Nothing has been spent.

May I drop the “Veo only” requirement and use a free-plan-compatible model for your original **5-second widescreen clip with rain sounds** instead? It would still use credits; I’d confirm the cost before generating.
dialog.user: Keep Veo 3 only—don’t substitute another model. If it can’t run on my free plan, don’t generate or spend anything.

turns.agent: Understood. Veo 3 can’t run on your current free plan, so I won’t generate anything or substitute another model. No credits have been spent.
